what_i_did: Wrote 10 single-mode dev tasks with answers computed or brute-force verified in python (unique topological orders, permutations for assignments and time windows, exhaustive packing, Dijkstra, timetable enumeration, pair enumeration)
Validated with lab/validate_tasks.py (10/10 valid) and piloted 3 rounds on the baseline with lab/pilot.py --show, reading every reply
Round 1 -> 2: suite was at floor, replaced 7 tasks with simpler instances and raised max_tokens to 300 where working is allowed
Round 2 -> 3: let dev-05 and dev-09 show working before the answer, reworded the working instruction of dev-10

After round 3: widened the dev-05 check to accept a correct 'ANSWER: Pell' written at the end of a prose line (the exact check compared the whole line). Prompt unchanged; not re-piloted (3-round limit); the recorded round-3 reply was rescored offline with core.score_episode and passes
Wrote tasks/planning/spec.md with conventions, pitfalls, an example and five sub-themes

final_file_baseline.basis: round-3 measured replies (4/10) plus dev-05, whose recorded round-3 reply passes the corrected checker when rescored offline; inference is deterministic and the prompt is unchanged, but the final file was not run end to end a fourth time

incident: Between pilot round 3 and the final checker fix, another agent (designer-constraints, self-reported in swarm/events.jsonl) ran my generator script from the shared scratchpad, which reset tasks/planning/dev.json to its round-1 content. Round 3 itself ran on the correct file (its replies match the round-3 prompts). I rebuilt the file by re-running my deterministic scripts in order (generator, round-2 patch, round-3 patch, checker fix), re-validated 10/10, and moved the scripts into a private subfolder.
